kind_why: A combat surf map: built to fight on rather than to time (see notes). 'arena' keeps it out of g2gfast's rotation, vote and nominations -- it stays installed, loadable with `map`, and listed on M as combat -- and marks it for game-arena's deathmatch.

sealed_teleports.note: The floor catch-all teleports aim at four jail cells (a 4 m wide closet under the map with a timed water and explosion trap). Their only way out is push_jailout, a trigger_push the map starts disabled and a script enables, and glass_jailbottom, a script-driven door; the importer runs no outputs, so a faller was stuck for good (found by headless_imported's fall-out walk, pit 19). Dropped, a fall is the map's own drop back into the fight.
